Thanks for flagging. I pulled the routing rules: territory assignment is account-based; if account-level mapping exists it takes precedence over self-serve lead creation. That said, sales playbook says: when a legitimate inbound contact signs up and explicitly requests a demo, SDRs handling inbound should execute the initial demo and qualify, then pass to AE for deeper engagements — unless AE has an active cadence or booked meeting prior to the inbound request.

In this case: Logan, you mentioned you had outreach and booked the 10:00 slot. Can you confirm the booking timestamp? If your booking predates Samantha's signup or acceptance, AE ownership stands. If not, SDR (Marissa) should run the initial 30m. Either way we should: 1) avoid double-booking Samantha, 2) reconcile HubSpot duplicates.

Attaching screenshot of the duplicate record and HubSpot timestamps.
[attachment: screenshot-duplicate-lead.png]

Proposed resolution: whoever has the confirmed meeting on the calendar (with customer acceptance) will run the initial demo; other rep will join as next-step AE. If calendar acceptance is ambiguous, default to the inbound SDR owner for the first touch.

Ethan Park
SDR Manager | Redwood Inference
